additions.note: Baidu published Apache-2.0 checkpoints for the post-trained 280B mixture-of-experts model with 14B active parameters and 1M context. Builds include BF16, FP8 and a mixed FP8/FP4 checkpoint.
Apache-2.0 translation family covering 102 languages, with 1.8B, 7B, and 30B-A3B checkpoints. Tencent also published a translation evaluation suite.
Conversation-tuned GPT-6.2 Sol snapshot rolled out in the Chat tab for Plus, Pro, Business, and eligible Enterprise users.

Multimodal flagship with 1M context for coding and long-running agent tasks. It reuses 28 transformer layers across two passes. Z.ai launched it for GLM Coding Plan subscribers and listed the general API as forthcoming.
Early-access hosted model for agents with 512K context, tool calling, and structured outputs. Upstage released it in the API and Playground ahead of the planned December general release.
MIT-licensed multimodal mixture-of-experts model with 124B total and 5.5B active parameters. It accepts text, images, and video and targets agent workflows.
Apache-2.0 update of the English and German reasoning model. The 75B mixture-of-experts model uses 3.44B active parameters and offers adjustable reasoning effort and downloadable GGUF builds.
554B mixture-of-experts model built with NVIDIA on Nemotron 3 Ultra. It maintains a compact memory state across turns and ships under OpenMDW-1.1.
Apache-2.0 vision-language model for robot manipulation. The full 27B checkpoint can invoke robot policies, review proposed trajectories, and generate control code.

Compact on-device multimodal family with 2B and 4B variants. A shared vision-language backbone supports text generation, multimodal embeddings, and structured decisions. Tencent released Transformers and GGUF weights under Apache-2.0.

Hosted real-time voice model that can keep a conversation going while a background model handles a task and relay the result when ready. At launch Alibaba listed availability in Beijing and Singapore.
Hosted audio understanding model that transcribes speech, separates voices from background audio, and describes speakers, music, and other sounds. At launch Alibaba listed availability in Beijing.
Hosted stealth coding model offered in Qoder for a limited preview with adjustable thinking effort. Qoder did not identify the underlying developer.
MIT-licensed medical reasoning model with 560B total and 25B active parameters, built for clinical workflows and complex medical reasoning. FP8 and MXFP4 weights are available.
MIT-licensed multimodal medical model with 124B total and 5.5B active parameters, trained for medical image understanding, report generation, and clinical reasoning.
Sarvam switched the existing sarvam-105b and sarvam-105b-conversations API endpoints to its 1711 checkpoint for tool use, long conversations, and Indian languages.
Image generation and editing model with up to 4K output, up to five generation reference images, and a Precise Edit API with optional masking.
